shortDescription: Module to manage storage connections in oVirt

options.name: address
options.description: Address of the storage server. E.g.: myserver.mydomain.com

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: force
options.description: This parameter is relevant only when updating a connection. If I(true) the storage domain don't have to be in I(MAINTENANCE) state, so the storage connection is updated.

options.name: id
options.description: Id of the storage connection to manage.

options.name: mount_options
options.description: Option which will be passed when mounting storage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: nfs_retrans
options.description: The number of times to retry a request before attempting further recovery actions. Range 0 to 65535.

options.name: nfs_timeout
options.description: The time in tenths of a second to wait for a response before retrying NFS requests. Range 0 to 65535.

options.name: nfs_version
options.description: NFS version. One of: I(auto), I(v3), I(v4) or I(v4_1).

options.name: password
options.description: A CHAP password for logging into a target.

options.name: path
options.description: Path of the mount point of the storage. E.g.: /path/to/my/data

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: port
options.description: Port of the iSCSI storage server.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the storage connection be present or absent.

options.name: storage
options.description: Name of the storage domain to be used with storage connection.

options.name: target
options.description: The target IQN for the storage device.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: type
options.description: Storage type. For example: I(nfs), I(iscsi), etc.

options.name: username
options.description: A CHAP username for logging into a target.

options.name: vfs_type
options.description: Virtual File System type.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
